question: A 32-year-old Caucasian female required a kidney transplant 3 years ago. She presents with elevated creatinine levels (2.6 mg/dl) and an elevated blood pressure (160/90 mmHg). A biopsy is taken of the transplanted kidney. Following histological findings, a diagnosis of chronic graft rejection is made. Which of the following is NOT a likely finding?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Chronic graft rejection -> Interstitial fibrosis -> Glomerular destruction -> Tubular atrophy -> Graft arteriosclerosis -> Glomerular crescents -> opb. Glomerular destruction -> 95%
CHAIN: Chronic graft rejection -> Interstitial fibrosis -> Tubular atrophy -> Graft arteriosclerosis -> Glomerular crescents -> opa. Interstitial fibrosis -> 90%
CHAIN: Chronic graft rejection -> Interstitial fibrosis -> Glomerular destruction -> Graft arteriosclerosis -> opa. Interstitial fibrosis -> 85%
analysis: Chronic graft rejection typically involves interstitial fibrosis, tubular atrophy, graft arteriosclerosis, and glomerular destruction. Glomerular crescents are not a typical finding in chronic graft rejection.
